cohort: 4941 births at the Buea Regional Hospital (BRH) in Cameroon from 2007 to 2012
finding: The rate of cesarean section in the BRH is relatively high for a suburban population in a developing country, and neonates born from cesarean section had higher odds of having a low first minute APGAR score.
mod_finding: Neonates born via cesarean section had higher odds of having a low first minute APGAR score (OR = 6.6, 95% CI 5.7-7.7; p < 0.01).
